key_claims: Training zones are determined by threshold test results and provide a common language for coaches to communicate intensity prescriptions to athletes
The body adapts to training stress, causing plateaus; coaches must vary training stimulus through periodization to continue making fitness gains
A sample threshold session structure is 60 minutes in zone 2 endurance with two 15-minute periods in zone 4 intensity
Power and zones enable precise communication compared to speed alone, which cannot account for gradient, wind, or other variables
Periodization is applied both at macro level (across training plan) and micro level (within weekly training with interspersed intensity and rest)
cluster_reasoning: Episode directly addresses training zones, periodization, threshold testing, and intensity variation—core coaching methodology pillars with no secondary content across nutrition, strength, or recovery domains.
